finding.explanation: The function now returns only the 'name' property of the first row instead of the full user object, breaking the return type contract (User | undefined). Additionally, when no user is found, rows is an empty array, making rows[0] undefined and accessing .name throw a TypeError, whereas the original function returned undefined in this case.

This introduces a correctness regression if the intent was to retain retry for all 5xx responses while adding retry for 429.
